title: Pass the Pattern · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Pass the Pattern · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and a three-action pattern of gentle claps and taps. The first player performs the first action, the partner the second, and the first player the third. The pair completes the selected pattern in order. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Pass the Pattern, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The pair completes the selected pattern in order.
recall.why: The pair completes the selected pattern in order.
